clue.text: Store fat eating every brand

indicators.note: the fat swallows the other pieces, so they sit inside it

parts.note: suet is hard animal fat used in cooking
per means for each, as in 'a pound per head'
a mark is a brand or trademark

explanation.surface: A shop's cooking fat seems to absorb every product label on the shelves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eating' is the container signal: the fat surrounds the rest. 'Store' is a noun here, a shop, not the verb to keep.
explanation.definitionFit: A large self-service grocery shop is a kind of store.

clue.text: Show 'American Idol' cut short

indicators.note: the idol word loses its final letter

parts.note: a hero is an idol

explanation.surface: A reference to the TV talent contest American Idol, trimmed.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks suggest the TV talent show, but 'American' and 'Idol' work separately; 'cut short' drops the idol word's last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To usher someone in is to show or escort them to a place.

clue.text: Laments English members taking to wit

indicators.note: the members take in the to-wit abbreviation, holding it inside

parts.note: legs are limbs, members of the body
i.e. (id est) means that is, to wit

explanation.surface: English body parts mourn, namely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' is a container signal: the members take in the abbreviation for 'to wit', which is i.e. (Latin id est).
explanation.definitionFit: Mournful poems or songs for the dead are laments.

clue.text: Average detective with average case

indicators.note: the second average forms a case around the detective

parts.note: the mean is the arithmetic average
DI is a Detective Inspector

explanation.surface: An ordinary detective handling an ordinary case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Average' appears twice: the first is the definition, the second is the wordplay. 'case' means the second average encloses the detective.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle value in a ranked set is one kind of average in statistics.

clue.text: Salutations concerning glasses around time

parts.note: re means about, concerning

indicators.note: the glasses go around the time abbreviation

parts.note: specs is short for spectacles

explanation.surface: Greetings about spectacles over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' makes the glasses enclose the time letter; 'concerning' is the usual crossword signal for the short Latin 're'.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying one's regards or polite greetings, as in 'pay your respects', are salutations.

clue.text: Reproduce flightless bird, extinct?

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird
late can mean dead, and the question mark admits extinct is a stretch

explanation.surface: Recreate a flightless bird that may have died out, like the dodo.
explanation.definitionFit: To copy or imitate something is to reproduce it.

clue.text: 'Cosmopolitan' dictates I shop around

indicators.note: the letters of dictates I shop are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A fashion magazine instructs where I should go shopping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' rearranges DICTATESISHOP. Cosmopolitan in quotes poses as the magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A worldly, cultured person is cosmopolitan, refined in taste.

clue.text: Good person speaks and falters

parts.note: ST, short for saint, is a good person
utters means speaks

explanation.surface: A virtuous person talks and then hesitates.
explanation.walkthrough: ST, saint, is the crossword good person.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak with halting repetitions is to falter in speech.

clue.text: Vender at times used this?

indicators.note: used signals that the letters of vender at times are worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A seller sometimes relied on a promotional notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' rearranges VENDERATTIMES, and the whole clue describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A seller now and then employs a public notice promoting goods, which is a commercial.

clue.text: Check in unrefined earth for pigment

indicators.note: the check abbreviation is placed inside the unrefined earth

parts.note: ore is rock or earth as mined, before metal is extracted
CH is the chess abbreviation for check

explanation.surface: A test of raw soil to see whether it can supply a colouring.
explanation.walkthrough: CH is the chess notation for check.
explanation.definitionFit: An earthy yellow-brown clay used as a colouring is a pigment.

clue.text: Offended being blown by detectives

indicators.note: by means beside, so the detectives stand next to the blown piece

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector, so DIS is detectives
gusted means blown by a sudden wind

explanation.surface: Someone is upset at being caught out or exposed by police officers.
explanation.walkthrough: DIS, plural of DI (Detective Inspector), comes first, then GUSTED.
explanation.definitionFit: Being repelled or revolted by something leaves you offended.

clue.text: History covers start of Moscow retreat

indicators.note: the history word wraps around the extra letter, holding it inside

parts.note: heritage is the history and traditions handed down

indicators.note: the opening letter of Moscow is taken

explanation.surface: A record of the past includes the beginning of a Russian city's place of retreat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covers' puts M inside HERITAGE; the Hermitage in St Petersburg adds a Russian flavour to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit's secluded dwelling is a place of withdrawal, a retreat.

clue.text: Cave found in verdant region

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the words verdant region, running across the gap

explanation.surface: A cavern is discovered in a green area of the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits in verdANT REgion.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a literary word for a cavern or cave.

clue.text: Miserable individual's beginning to miss cruelty

parts.note: miserable means sad
I is one individual, so individual's gives I'S

indicators.note: only the opening letter of miss is used

explanation.surface: An unhappy person starts to miss being unkind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'individual's' is I (one) plus the possessive S; 'beginning to' takes just the first letter of 'miss'.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking pleasure in inflicting pain is a form of cruelty.

clue.text: Abandon one consumed by record hit

parts.note: a disc is a record

indicators.note: the one is swallowed inside the other pieces

parts.note: lam means to hit or thrash
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Give up a single that was swallowed by a hit record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumed by' puts the one inside the hit word; lam is an informal word for thrash.
explanation.definitionFit: To renounce or give up a claim is to abandon it.

clue.text: Most extreme bother on small driving area

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the bother piece follows the others

parts.note: a tee is where a golfer drives from
a pest is a nuisance, a bother

explanation.surface: An extreme annoyance arises on a small golf tee.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'on' means placed after, so the bother comes last; the driving area is a golf tee, not a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of steep, meaning most excessive, as of prices, so most extreme.

clue.text: Overwhelm single sister over engagement

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means placed above the next piece

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, single
a nun is a religious sister
a date is an appointment, an engagement

explanation.surface: An unmarried sister is overwhelmed by thoughts of a betrothal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' in this down clue puts I and NUN above DATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood or swamp something is to overwhelm it.

clue.text: Forward part of shoe not without padding …

parts.note: an insole is the inner sole of a shoe

indicators.note: the word not loses its middle stuffing, leaving only its outside letters

explanation.surface: The front of a shoe that lacks cushioning, with an ellipsis leading on to the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without padding' strips the O from 'not', leaving NT.
explanation.definitionFit: Forward in the sense of cheeky or presumptuous means rudely bold.

clue.text: Place for soldiers to go on manoeuvres?

definitions.text: Place for soldiers to go on manoeuvres?

parts.words: Place for soldiers to go on manoeuvres?
parts.note: to go is a euphemism for using a toilet, and a military camp toilet is what troops in the field use

explanation.surface: A location soldiers head for during an exercise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Place to go' reads as a destination, but 'go' is the euphemism for relieving oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: A camp or military toilet, often a trench or pit, is used by troops.

clue.text: … helps son wearing wellies, perhaps

indicators.note: the son is inside the footwear, as if wearing it

parts.note: wellies (wellington boots, rubber rain boots) are an example of boots

explanation.surface: Continuing from the shoe clue: a lad pulling on rubber boots is a help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wearing' puts S inside BOOTS. Wellies are British slang for wellington boots, waterproof rubber boots.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a lift or encouragement is to support or assist.

clue.text: Oscar event oration, having a bouquet

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a do is a party or event
a rant is a long impassioned speech

explanation.surface: An award ceremony speech is made while holding a bunch of flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Oscar event' and 'bouquet' suggest an awards night, but each word is a separate piece.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective this means giving off a scent, so having a fragrance or aroma.

clue.text: Exhibitionist in French street, thus quietly revolting

indicators.note: revolting means turning over, so the pieces are read upwards

parts.note: rue is French for street
so means thus
P is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A show-off in a Paris street is causing a quiet disgust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolting' looks like disgust but signals turning the pieces over in this down clue; P is piano, quietly in music.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who acts affectedly to impress others is a show-off, an exhibitionist.

clue.text: Budget vote leader ignored

indicators.note: the vote word drops its first letter, its leader

parts.note: a ballot is a vote

explanation.surface: A spending plan is voted on while the party leader is overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader ignored' drops the B from BALLOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To budget money is to set aside or apportion it, a verb sense.

clue.text: Some lingo adapted for new word

indicators.note: the letters of some lingo are altered into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A bit of jargon gets changed into a freshly coined term.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adapted' rearranges SOMELINGO.
explanation.definitionFit: A coinage, a freshly invented term or expression, is exactly this.

clue.text: Writer of one's biography in the ascendancy

indicators.note: in a down clue rising letters are read upwards, so the hidden run is reversed
the letters lie inside the words one's biography

explanation.surface: An author whose life story is on the rise in popularity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' hides NESBI in oNE'S BIography; 'the ascendancy' reads it upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norwegian dramatist who wrote A Doll's House is a famous playwright, so a writer.

clue.text: Dispose of ale in time, drunk

indicators.note: the letters of ale in time are reeling about, rearranged

explanation.surface: Finish off the beer in good time while intoxicated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges ALEINTIME.
explanation.definitionFit: To get rid of or remove something completely is to dispose of it.

clue.text: Incendiarism against right saw off nominee initially

indicators.note: the first letters of the five words before it are taken in turn

explanation.surface: A fire-raising protest against what is right sees off a candidate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nominee initially' looks like it supplies only N, but 'initially' covers all five words: Against Right Saw Off Nominee.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately setting fire to property is the crime of arson.

clue.text: Strident babbling about European trap

indicators.note: the babbling word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: prating means talking foolishly at length, babbling
a net is a trap

explanation.surface: Loud, harsh chatter concerns a European snare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strident' is the definition, not anagram fodder, and 'babbling' is a synonym, not an anagram signal; 'about' puts the European and the trap inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A strident, shrill sound is piercing, cutting through everything.
